title: The compatible map from the total fraction ring to minimal-prime localizations is bijective
statement: Let R be a reduced Noetherian commutative ring, let t be a natural number, let q : Fin t ≃ {p : PrimeSpectrum R // p.asIdeal ∈ minimalPrimes R}, and let φ_i : FractionRing R →+* R_{q_i} be ring maps compatible with R. Then the induced map FractionRing R →+* Π_i R_{q_i} is bijective.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 02LX, final product decomposition step
